name: Calendar Alarms - EarlyOtter
subtitle: Auto alarms from your calendar
promotionalText: Your alarm, set by your calendar. EarlyOtter finds your first event, subtracts prep and commute, and wakes you right on time. No early plans? Sleep in.
description:
Your alarm, set by your calendar.

EarlyOtter finds your first event, subtracts prep and commute, and wakes you exactly when you need to. No early plans? Sleep in.

• Works with Apple and Google Calendar
• Custom rules for different mornings
• Rings even on silent
• Private: your events never leave your iPhone
whatsNew:
• A new look, inspired by a starry night swim
• Regular alarms: repeat days, one-time dates, labels and snooze, right next to your calendar alarms
• Original alarm tones, made for EarlyOtter
• Alarms now show your event's name
• Tap any day to see it as a planner: your alarm, prep, commute and every event
• Hold and drag the alarm to move it for just that day
• Simpler rule editing and a cleaner Settings screen
• Fixed an old alarm ringing after a restart
• New: anonymous usage data (Settings → Permissions). Counts only, never your calendar details. You can turn it off at any time.
